page_title: LAZ 1-2 FIO | Lazio v Fiorentina 26/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Antonio Rapuano is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' Pedro (Lazio) blows a good opportunity to score. Without any hesitation he fires in a shot from mid range, but the ball crashes against the right post!
90+7' Raffaele Palladino almost immediately gets a second yellow card from referee Antonio Rapuano and will have to vacate the bench!
90+6' The linesman makes the right call and Lazio will have a corner.
90+5' David de Gea blocks a long-range effort from Adam Marusic (Lazio) towards the right side of the goal.
90+3' Holy smokes, you don't see that very often! Marco Baroni gets a second yellow card and has to leave the bench.
90+2' 1 - 2 GOAL! Adam Marusic (Lazio) scores with a header from close range after Elseid Hysaj headed a pin-point lofted cross into his path. It's 1:2.
90+1' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Lazio.
90+1' The corner from Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is intercepted by David de Gea.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Marco Baroni isn't happy on the touchline after referee Antonio Rapuano shows him a yellow card.
90' Pedro (Lazio) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
89' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
89' Mario Gila (Lazio) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Lazio.
86' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar.
86' Substitution. Michael Folorunsho makes his way off the pitch and Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) comes on as his replacement.

86' Pedro (Lazio) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle for an infringement. Fiorentina are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
85' Pedro (Lazio) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
85' Total attempts – 18:7. The current number of shots on goal is 1:3.
83' Elseid Hysaj floats in a cross for Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio), whose header from near the penalty spot is really poor and goes well wide of the left post.
83' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper perfectly sets up the defensive wall and his effort is thwarted.
82' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Lazio win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
80' Today's match ends for Boulaye Dia who will be replaced by Tijjani Noslin (Lazio).

80' David de Gea doesn't have to worry about this one. Matteo Guendouzi plays a pass into the feet of Pedro (Lazio), who is unable to find the target as his effort from inside the box goes high over the bar.
79' Lucas Beltran plays a pass to Moise Kean (Fiorentina), but he fails to get a decent shot away from inside the box and the ball goes high over the bar.
78' Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) hits a volley towards goal, but the goalkeeper denies him with a decent save.
77' Here is a change. Albert Gudmundsson is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina).
77' We are about to witness a subsitution. Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) for Dodo.
75' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) launches a cross from the corner, but David de Gea is alert to thwart the effort.
75' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lazio are going to take it.
75' Adam Marusic (Lazio) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lazio.
73' The corner kick from Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
72' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
71' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
70' Dodo (Fiorentina) attempts to delay the restart of play. The referee doesn't like it. Dodo (Fiorentina) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
70' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
70' The free kick is taken by Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina), but ball is cleared.
67' Corner kick. Lazio will have an opportunity.
67' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
67' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders. The referee blows his whistle, Lazio are awarded a corner kick.
66' It is time for a substitution. Elseid Hysaj (Lazio) is on for Luca Pellegrini.
66' Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
65' Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle. Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) commits a foul after dangerous play. It's a free kick to Fiorentina, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
63' Substitution. Yacine Adli will be replaced by Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina).
63' This is an obvious ploy to delay the restart of play from Yacine Adli (Fiorentina). The referee is firm and issues Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) a deserved yellow card.
63' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) is given a second yellow card for some unsportsmanlike conduct off the pitch.
62' Referee Antonio Rapuano halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Raffaele Palladino, then shows him a yellow.
58' Lazio work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
58' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) sends a precise pass into the box, but Nicolo Rovella loses the one-on-one with the defender. The ball is out of play. Lazio win a corner kick.
58' Pedro (Lazio) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
57' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
55' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
55' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) attempts to find Adam Marusic, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
54' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
54' The game is interrupted now, Taty Castellanos (Lazio) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
53' The ball is cleared after Dodo (Fiorentina) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
52' Mario Gila (Lazio) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
51' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) takes a short corner kick.
51' Pedro (Lazio) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag and Lazio will take a corner.
50' Half-chance! Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) plays a pass into the box, but David de Gea reacts well to snuff out the attack.
49' A cross into the box from Pedro (Lazio) is cleared.
48' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Lazio win a free kick.
46' Half-time substitution. Marco Baroni decided to make a change. Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) is replaced by Nicolo Rovella.
46' Half-time substitution. Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) will not participate anymore and Pedro is coming on.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.

45+2' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Antonio Rapuano blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Lazio are awarded the free kick.
45+1' Adam Marusic (Lazio) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
45' Boulaye Dia (Lazio) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
41' Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
40' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) is able to continue to play.
38' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
38' Corner kick. Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is ready to send the ball into the box.
37' The resulting corner from Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) is cleared by the opposition's defence. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lazio.
37' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Lazio.
34' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) blows a clear opportunity to score as he rattles the right post from point-blank range.
33' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Taty Castellanos, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
32' Lazio enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
28' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
28' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. Fiorentina will have a chance to score from a corner.
26' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
25' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
21' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 2:4. The number of shots on goal at present is 0:3.
21' Referee Antonio Rapuano sees the trip by Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Lazio will take a free kick near the side line.
17' 0 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Dodo puts the ball on a plate for Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina), who has an easy finish with a header into an empty net. The score is 0:2.

15' Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the roof of the net. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Ivan Provedel makes a comfortable save.
13' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is repeatedly being caught offside.
11' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Robin Gosens plays the ball to the feet of Yacine Adli (Fiorentina), who hits a tremendous first-time shot inside the right post. The goalkeeper was unable to keep it out. 0:1.
10' Yacine Adli (Fiorentina) will take a corner kick.
6' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over.
4' Mattia Zaccagni delivers a perfect cross for Adam Marusic (Lazio), who has simple job scoring from close range but somehow contrives to send the ball just wide of the right post.
4' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
3' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Lazio get a corner.
2' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
1' A pass from Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina) is intercepted by Ivan Provedel and the move breaks down.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Fiorentina will kick the game off.
Antonio Rapuano is introduced as the referee for today's match.
